caution: Lab samples under DevTools throttling on one machine. Not field data: they do not establish p75 LCP, INP or CLS, and TBT is not INP.
note: paired: base-url is the feature build (feature/seo-17-mobile-performance working tree), compare-url is origin/develop 7671090; both production builds with NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPHQL_URL at the fixture API, served by next start at the same time, samples alternating route by route; fixture API 0 ms

profile.name: desktop
profile.description: 1350x940 at DPR 1, no CPU slowdown, 40 ms RTT, 10 Mbps both ways (Lighthouse desktop values, applied as DevTools throttling)
profile.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

method.isolation: new headless Chrome and empty profile per sample (cold cache)
method.benchmark: benchmarkIndex is the Lighthouse ultradumbBenchmark score (string building for 500 ms) measured unthrottled on about:blank before each sample; it shows how fast this machine is before the fixed slowdown is applied
method.settle: load event, then 2000 ms without network and 5000 ms without a long task, capped at 45000 ms
method.tbt: sum of long-task time over 50 ms between FCP and a longtask-based TTI (last long task before a 5 s quiet window); an approximation of Lighthouse TBT
method.transfer: encoded bytes per request; script-first-load is parser-initiated, script-deferred is requested by script (dynamic imports), prefetch is router prefetch or lowest-priority script
